Picks the curve that the volume of 3D sounds falls off by with distance, for the sounds that play now and the ones that start later. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
; Everything with the curve of the original, from now on.
ListenerFalloff 1
```
@param mode  `0` is the curve of this runtime, `1` the curve of the original and `2` the curve of SoLoud, see [CreateListener](CreateListener). Anything else is a runtime error.
@gap [SetFalloff](SetFalloff) only changes the sounds that start after it, and [SetChannelFalloff](SetChannelFalloff) one sound. A curve can not glide from one to the other.
